opportunities.name: GitHub developer lead research and email draft
opportunities.description: Search a GitHub username, open the user profile and their top repo, then compose an email to the hiring address with follower count, top repo stats and latest post for a given role.
steps: Click GitHub global search and type the username
Press Enter and click the Users results tab
Open the top/pinned repository and note stars and language
Open mail compose, enter recipient hiring@example.com
Type body with followers, top repo, stars, language, latest post

opportunities.name: Wikipedia lookup plus Wayback snapshot and note
opportunities.description: Look up a person/place on Wikipedia, optionally check an Internet Archive snapshot of a related site, and save a summary note.
steps: Click Wikipedia search and type the topic
Press Enter and read the summary
Optionally open archive.org, enter the site URL, select year and snapshot
Open Notes, create new note with the summarized facts

instances.values: Midtown Manhattan; note with library walk
